newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Bunds extend gains after U.S. jobs data.
newsitem.headline: German Bunds extend gains after U.S. jobs data.

text.p: German Bunds extended their gains in late dealings on Friday, hitting fresh contract highs after a surprising drop in U.S. September jobs data.

December DTB Bund futures, which posted mild losses earlier in the day, were up 48 basis points from Wednesday's close at 99.75 at 1534 GMT. Ten-year Bunds were up at 102.03, with yields down to 5.96 percent.

The market turned higher after news that U.S. September non-farm payrolls fell 40,000, against the consensus forecast for a rise of 166,000. Dealers said U.S. data would continue to play a decisive role next week.
